Interface GameCommand

All Superinterfaces:
Command, Message, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
MoveTotemCommand, ResolveActionsCommand
public sealed interface GameCommand extends Command permits MoveTotemCommand, ResolveActionsCommand
Marker interface for commands sent during an active game.

Each game command carries the sender's nickname() as a record component. This field is not used for live request routing: while a game is in progress the server resolves the sender from the connection's clientId -> nickname mapping held by ControllerManager, so the transport client sends the field blank.

The nickname is retained so that each command is self-descriptive once serialized, in particular when written to the NDJSON command log by CommandLogger (where GameController fills it with the real sender). Crash-recovery replay, however, reads the sender from the log record's envelope nickname (CommandRecord.nickname()), not from this field: the value carried here is redundant but kept to preserve the serialized command shape and backward compatibility of existing logs.
